title: Building
description: The building the property belongs to. Its attributes are shared by all units in the building, so they are kept apart from the unit itself.

@type.description: Must be or contain `erdif:Building`, usually next to a schema.org type.

constructionType.description: Main load-bearing construction of the building.

lastRenovationYear.description: Year of the last major renovation of the building.

floorsAboveGround.description: Number of above-ground floors including the ground floor.

elevator.description: Flag indicating whether the building has an elevator.
